Docket 1.3.88

**"Competing pages" now understands series, sections and templates.**

The competing-pages finding looks for pages chasing the same search, and it
was grouping pages that plainly are not:

- *A series and its index.* An index page and its entries — "Home Tour" beside
  "Home Tour: <a home>" — are a section and its items. Each entry is found by
  what follows the shared name.
- *One template, different subjects.* Pages titled from one pattern with a
  single part changed — a season, a cuisine, a technique — are separate pages
  about separate things.
- *Different sizes.* Pages for 4-inch and 6-inch versions of a part name
  different items, the way two version numbers do.

Still reported, because they really do compete: the same subject written up
twice, annual pages that differ only by year, and titles that differ only by
"easy" or "best".

**Slow first responses behind a fast cache.** When pages are slow the first
time they are requested and fast the second — a cache in front of a slow
server — the speed finding now says exactly that, instead of calling the whole
site slow. First visitors and search engines crawling rarely visited pages
still wait for the slow server, and the advice says how to fix it.

99 checks across 13 areas.
